records.text: Owens said Howard Hughes died aboard a jet owned by Robert Graf, whose company became Duncan Aviation.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He was aboard a jet, actually, a jet that was owned by a man named Robert Graff, G-R-A-F. ... He was the founder of Robert Graff, Inc., which became Duncan Aviation. His business partner was Donald Duncan.

verification.notes: Historical accounts place Hughes's death aboard Robert Graf's Learjet while en route to Houston. Duncan Aviation's own anniversary history says Graf was a partner in the Beechcraft distributorship Donald Duncan joined in 1956, establishing the business lineage summarized in the statement.
